thread:
alina: Heads up 1: partner (HelioSystems) wants both hosted marketplace listing and an "on-prem SI bundle" download flow. Legal asked for a short statement we can show publicly plus the required addenda for the partner portal.

rafael: Quick summary from legal: public listing needs a compact redistribution blurb + a link to the full partner licensing packet. For downloads we require a Redistribution Addendum and SI Integration Addendum.

thomas: Can we get the one-liner for the listing? Ops needs the copy to wire into the marketplace UI. Keep it under 160 chars.

rafael: One-liner suggestion: "Available as hosted API or partner-delivered download; redistribution permitted to verified partners under Partner Redistribution Addendum."

alina: Nice. Legal also insists on provenance metadata for any derivative weights (quantized/pruned). We'll need marketplace manifest fields for artifact_checksum, origin_url, and derivative_flag.

ella: From comms perspective we want to avoid burying licensing in the copy. Put the one-liner and an inline "learn more" to the addendum in the listing. Also plan a joint PR + docs release cadence. Proposed timeline: soft partner-only availability 2026-11-01, public listing 2026-11-05, joint blog 2026-11-08. Thoughts?

thomas: Works for infra, but ops needs SKU entitlements before soft launch. Ops prefers discrete SKUs (hosted, download) for billing and rate limiting.

alina: Legal prefers discrete SKUs too so we can tie distribution rights per SKU. Also want a checkbox during onboarding where partner explicitly accepts derivative rights for quantized variants.

rafael: Exactly. We'll require partners to acknowledge: "I will not redistribute unredacted training data; derivative artifacts must include provenance metadata and adhere to Addendum B (derivatives)."

ops-bot: Ticket OPS-7789 created: add artifact_checksum, origin_url, derivative_flag, sku_type fields to marketplace manifest. Assignee: ops-infra. ETA 2026-10-20.

alina: Action items: 1) @rafael upload public one-liner + link to addenda to partner repo (due EOD). 2) @ops-infra (via ops-bot) to add manifest fields and SKU separation (ETA above). 3) @thomas to update SDK gating so marketplace download artifacts include checksums and provenance metadata (due +3 days). 4) @ella to draft partner comms and embargo schedule (due +5 days).

thomas: Question: technical constraints for SI bundles 1: can partners ship quantized variants that change API signature (different input shapes)? We should disallow API-breaking variants unless we version the SKU.

rafael: Good point. License allows derivatives but not API changes without explicit compatibility testing and a versioned SKU. We'll add that to Addendum B.

alina: OK closing: I'll update the partner onboarding doc and add the checkbox language. Link to draft: https://redwood.internal/partners/heliosystems/176543 (private). Ping if blockers. :white_check_mark:
